As Ryo fights to keep Talpa from absorbing him into his armor, the Ancient One tells Ryo about Talpa's origins and helps Ryo understand the armors can be used for good as long as the heroes stay determined to fight against evil.

Despite vanquishing Talpa and restoring the city and its people, the heroes remain unsettled due to the lingering evil forces and the toll the Inferno Armor is taking on Ryo; a new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the armor for himself.

Saranbo gathers forces to prepare to go after Ryo's armor; full of regret and not wanting his friends to get hurt in his defense, a weakened Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.
Mia finds evidence in her grandfather's notes of special swords Ryo can use with his new armor; Lord Saber Stryke and his tiger attack the heroes over possession of the swords.
With the heroes determined to get the Soul Swords from Lord Saber Stryke, but unable to stand up to him in combat, White Blaze risks his life to steal the swords for Ryo.
On the way to investigate a volcanic eruption that was mysteriously halted by ice, the heroes encounter a new villain who wants to test their strength.

Lepka attempts to escape with his hostage Lana in tow, but Conan won't give up on his friend.
As earthquakes rattle Industria, its residents fear that another cataclysm will occur; Lepka seeks to revive the massive warplane, Gigant, to make the world his own.
As Lepka attacks, Conan infiltrates Gigant to try and stop him.
The people of High Harbor rejoice as Dyce and Jimsy are finally rescued.

20 years after a devastating war, an old man and a young boy named Conan live on Remnant Island; one day, Conan finds a girl named Lana on the shore; when Lana is abducted by soldiers, Conan and his grandfather must spring into action.
Conan travels by plane and sea as he tries to rescue Lana from the clutches of Industria soldiers.

Moving to a new town is tough, and with no friends, it can be scary; in Satsuki's case, that last part isn't helped any when she, her little brother, and three kids from school end up in the old schoolhouse, which happens to be haunted by ghosts.
A ghost invades the school's bathrooms, and it's up to Satsuki and the gang to find out how to put it back to sleep; the old book left by Satsuki's mom just might be the ticket.

The school play is coming up, but the boy in the lead role is scared; he makes a wish for the gymnasium to catch fire, and it does; when the play moves to being held in the old schoolhouse, the boy wishes to be injured and he is.

While in the old schoolhouse, Satsuki hears a haunting melody drifting through the halls; the only trouble is the lack of a pianist; if Satsuki hears the melody a total of four times, she'll die; the gang saddles up to put the ghostly piano to sleep.

Lum's childhood friend Ran comes to Earth, but she's here to seek revenge on Lum for all times she got her in trouble when they were both little; she tries to suck out Ataru's youth by kissing him.
Lum nabs Ataru's diary from the future, causing Ataru to get into a boatload of trouble when he reads too far ahead; while getting ready for class, Mendou finds an alien baby in his locker.
A fairy and her master put Ataru's class to sleep. While having a poetry contest, the gang stumbles upon a strange woman.

In "Duel. Ataru vs. Ataru" Ataru gets divided into two beings that are completely different. In "Walking to a Nightmare" Ataru goes to a deep sleep in class and his dreams make Mendo furious at Ataru and seconds away from killing him.
Ippo invites Kumi to the zoo; Kumi lets Ippo know that she was the one who wrote "idiot" outside the gym; Sendo's grandma tells Iimura Mari about Sendo's childhood and how he was brought up.
Ippo reads Mari's article; Ippo invites Nekota to his fight; both Sendo and Ippo have their weigh-in; Sendo and Ippo begin their rematch with Ippo getting a very early knockdown on Sendo.
Sendo and Ippo's fight begins guns blazing with the two giving each other blow for blow; Ippo finds out that Sendo has the advantage of having a bigger frame.
Ippo starts the third round by charging at Sendo but then hesitates, which leads to Sendo beating Ippo all through the third round; the fourth round is a different story, being more in favor of Ippo.
